entries.choice_handling_note: Pull From Darkness is a per-use decision to accept backlash for an invocation use; it does not create a persistent character-build choice.

power_providers.label: Experimentalist Discoveries
power_providers.description: Choose an Alchemist discovery at 3rd level and every four levels thereafter; the 20th-level selection may be a grand discovery when its prerequisites are met.

resources.name: Alchemical Boosts
resources.description: Prepare a number of boosts equal to the casting ability modifier. Consuming one raises caster level by the current Forbidden Lore scaling for one minute.

resources.name: Insights
resources.description: Daily insight uses equal the chosen practitioner modifier and recover after eight hours.

resources.name: Strain Bonus
resources.description: Temporary base attack bonus increase; failure to capitalize on it causes the printed fatigue, exhaustion, unconsciousness, or daze consequence.

power_providers.label: Unseelie Rogue Talents
power_providers.description: Choose Rogue Talents at levels 6, 12, and 18; advanced talents become legal at level 12.

resources.name: Sneak Attack Applies
resources.description: Toggle when the target qualifies. Damage advances by 1d6 at every odd Fey Adept level and may apply once to a qualifying sphere effect within 30 feet.

resources.name: Sneak Attack Applies
resources.description: Toggle when the target qualifies. Sneak attack advances at levels 1, 5, 9, 13, and 17.

resources.name: Mist Form
resources.description: Toggle the archetype's modified gaseous swarm form while unencumbered.

resources.name: Kinetic Overload
resources.description: Rounds per day equal 4 + casting ability modifier plus 2 per level after 1st. While active, the printed telekinetic maneuver and pummel rules apply.
